description: Source code for the MidiFile class implementing MIDI playback functionality within the Android Open Source Project, including thread management, file handling, and audio rendering.

classes.name: MidiFile
classes.description: Class managing MIDI file playback, including file handling, thread management, and audio rendering.

methods.name: MidiFile
methods.description: Constructor initializing MIDI playback engine and resources.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks if the MIDI engine is properly initialized.

methods.name: ~MidiFile
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the MIDI data source from a file path.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the MIDI data source from a file descriptor.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the MIDI engine for playback.

methods.name: prepareAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously prepares the MIDI engine.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts MIDI playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops MIDI playback.

methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the MIDI track.

methods.description: Pauses MIDI playback.

methods.description: Returns whether MIDI is currently playing.

methods.name: getCurrentPosition
methods.description: Retrieves current playback position.

methods.description: Retrieves total duration of the MIDI track.

methods.description: Releases resources associated with MIDI playback.

methods.description: Resets the MIDI engine state.

methods.name: reset_nosync
methods.description: Resets internal state without locking.

methods.name: setLooping
methods.description: Sets whether the MIDI should loop.

methods.name: render
